metadata_evidence.supports: Two dispersal schemes and logarithmic seed-mass classes; fleshiness compiled at species level.

decisions: Select taxonomy plus requested seed/fruit/dispersal columns by position, preserving all 5,201 species. Rename only the two Unassisted headers to retain source identity. Do not merge schemes or translate seedmass class codes into physical masses.
limitations: seedmass contains logarithmic class codes, not measured mass in grams; exact class boundaries are unresolved.
Some species have multiple dispersal assignments. The two classifications must not be combined as independent species counts.

descriptions.GroundM: terrestrial dispersers, mainly mammals and large birds
descriptions.ArboralD: arboreal vertebrates, mainly primates, bats and birds

seedmass_class_boundaries: Unresolved; source seedmass codes must not be converted to measured mass or assigned guessed bin boundaries.
